shared_elements: rows of small repeated signs arranged in registers
justification: Both surfaces carry shallow relief carving combining a figural element with rows of repeated small signs, and both include a disc-like circular motif, but these are generic correspondences. A shows a single frontal, massive anthropomorphic figure whose body itself is the carved field with symmetrical body-ornament motifs, while B shows dense horizontal registers of small repeated pictographic signs beside a separate profile figural scene — quite different organising schemes and conventions of depiction.
